runs.output_payload: {"tool_name":"AuditEmptyDraftingViews","panel_name":"ViewsAudit","description":"Scans the active document for drafting views containing zero graphical or annotation elements, cross-referencing sheet placement and view references to report candidates for deletion.","required_classes":["FilteredElementCollector","ViewDrafting","ViewType","Viewport","ElementOwnerViewFilter"],"edge_cases":["Drafting views that act as View Templates (IsTemplate is true) must be excluded.","Drafting views that contain hidden, sub-category turned off, or non-visible elements must not be falsely marked as empty.","Drafting views placed on sheets via Viewports must be flagged before deletion or modifications.","Drafting views referenced by Callout tags or View Reference elements in other views must be preserved.","Drafting views checked out or owned by other users in workshared models must be handled gracefully without throwing unhandled exceptions."]}

runs.output_payload: {"tool_name":"AuditEmptyDraftingViews","panel_name":"ViewsAudit","description":"Identifies and lists all drafting views in the active document that contain zero view-specific elements, noting sheet placement and template associations.","required_classes":["FilteredElementCollector","ViewDrafting","ViewType","Viewport","ElementCategoryFilter"],"edge_cases":["Drafting views marked as view templates (View.IsTemplate is true) must be excluded from the audit.","Empty drafting views currently placed on sheets must be flagged to prevent accidental deletion and viewport breakage.","Non-graphic or system elements (such as extents, crop boxes, or persistent parameter data) must not be counted as actual drafting elements.","Drafting views that contain only revision clouds, guide grids, or annotations must be distinguished from truly vacant views.","Handling models with worksharing enabled where drafting views might be checked out by other users."]}
